text.formatted: If you have Resistance to a damage type, damage of that type is halved against you (round down). Resistance is applied only once to an instance of damage. _See also_ "Playing the Game" ("Damage and Healing").
text.plain: If you have Resistance to a damage type, damage of that type is halved against you (round down). Resistance is applied only once to an instance of damage. See also "Playing the Game" ("Damage and Healing").
